title: Apple reportedly building server packed with M-series Ultra chips for AI
summary: Planned 2029 debut could make this Apple’s first enterprise server in decades.
reason: Media report of an AI industry hardware/infrastructure plan (Apple building AI server with M-series Ultra chips), covered by reputable outlet Ars Technica. Not a model release (no official owner model announcement) and not open-source tooling, so R3 applies.
